svg.aria-label: At left, compare the tangent at x = 1 mm with a secant using half-spacing 0.2 mm. At right, evaluate 170 steps for the same model. Orange is the exact-arithmetic error αxh²; blue is absolute error from actual NumPy evaluation. Horizontal axes represent position and step size, respectively.
